name: Caught in Your Web
source:
Camellia is over the moon when her new crush, Jane, agrees to go on a date with her. But when sightings of a serial murderer start getting too close for comfort, Camellia will have more than just romance to worry about.

[From [url=https://yf-kimi.itch.io/caught-in-your-web]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当卡梅莉亚的新欢简同意与她约会时，她欣喜若狂。但当连环杀人犯的目击事件变得越来越近而令人不安时，卡梅莉亚要担心的不仅仅是爱情。

[来自[url=https://yf-kimi.itch.io/caught-in-your-web]itch.io[/url]]
